data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate saw modest favourable prior year development in 2022, improving the loss ratio by 0.2pps (2021: 1.6pps). Favourable experience from prior year major losses was largely offset by adverse non-catastrophe related development across a handful of classes.

prior_year_events.impact_description: COVID-19 related reserves at 31 December 2022 are materially unchanged from those at 31 December 2021; syndicate has continued a comprehensive reserving approach for COVID-19 related losses.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2988 reported modest favourable prior year development for 2022, driven by favourable experience on prior-year major losses but largely offset by adverse non-catastrophe related development across a handful of classes. The net effect was a small release of approximately GBP 0.4m (around 0.18% of opening gross claims outstanding).
raw_causal_phrases: modest favourable prior year development in 2022, improving the loss ratio by 0.2pps (2021: 1.6pps).
Favourable experience from prior year major losses was largely offset by adverse non-catastrophe related development across a handful of classes.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities: Claims outstanding) prior year column. Prior year development calculated from the gross claims development triangle (Claims development table) by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2022, 2021) and comparing the current estimate to the previous diagonal; this yields a small favourable movement (-GBP 0.4m). No explicit gross prior-year movement GBP m figure was stated in the movement note; narrative only gave pps improvement. No LOB-specific prior-year movement amounts were provided.
